event_plausibility.reason: fewer than 3 prior prints to infer a cadence from

baseline.deadband_basis: one day at 20d realised vol (no earnings history on EDGAR)
baseline.deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
baseline.expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.

first_hunter_context.bar: Unsourced: no EPS or revenue consensus found (Nasdaq none per sweep; Stockopedia consensus EPS field blank, https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/x-financial-NYQ:XYF). Proxy bar is the Q2 2026 run-rate: revenue RMB993.6m and net income RMB47.0m (https://finviz.com/news/384651/x-financial-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). The company gave no Q3 guidance ('we are not providing quantitative guidance for the third quarter', Q2 call, https://www.webull.com/news/15460662063678464). print_vs_bar_pct is revenue against that Q2 run-rate. Because the bar is unsourced, every finding is capped small.
first_hunter_context.positioning_check: Short interest is about 86.5k shares, about 0.2% of float, 1.5-1.85 days to cover, as of about 2026-10-20 (equibles https://equibles.com/stocks/xyf/short-interest; fintel https://fintel.io/ss/us/XYF; snippet_only). The sweep had 84.6k shares and DTC 1.0 at 2026-09-15. That is not crowded, so there is no squeeze mechanism. There is no options market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so no skew. The dominant positioning is merger arbitrage: a US$6.03/ADS non-binding take-private bid from the controller (2026-11-06), with spot US$5.25, 12.9% below the offer, on 2026-11-25 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/xyf/history/). The +8.25% 20-day run-up is the bid day (+22.34% on 437k shares on 11-06, from US$4.70 to US$5.75), not earnings positioning. Since then the stock has drifted from 5.75 to 5.25.

evidence.text: The stock is pinned to a take-private bid. On 2026-11-06 Mangrove Coast Investment Limited (affiliated with Chairman/CEO Yue Tang, about 93.45% of voting power) proposed US$6.03 cash per ADS, a 28.3% premium to the prior close, financed by debt and equity with no financing condition. On 2026-11-18 the board formed a three-member special committee. Spot is US$5.25 on 11-25, 12.9% below the offer, so the Q3 numbers are a second-order input and any deal-progress line in the release or call (advisers named, talks under way) narrows the spread.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The bid day was +22.34% on 2026-11-06 (4.70 to 5.75, 437k shares against about 100k average). The stock then drifted to 5.25 by 11-25 with no further company news except the special-committee 6-K on 11-19 (11-19 -0.19%, 11-20 -1.71%). No prior XYF print happened under a pending bid.
evidence.why_not_priced: The bid itself is priced: that is the 22% day and the 12.9% spread. What is not priced is how the print interacts with it. Diligence is still pending per the letter, so a very weak quarter could raise fear of a cut price, while a deal-progress update would narrow the spread. If the market saw the print as a free-standing earnings event, XYF would have tracked QFIN's roughly -7.6% on 11-25. It closed +0.38% instead.
evidence.independence: Special-committee 6-K, 2026-11-19: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1725033/000110465926129959/tm2630265d1_6k.htm. Buyer's counsel announcement: https://www.hlc.com/en/news/hogan-lovells-cadwalader-advises-on-two-significant-greater-china-transactions-highlighting-integrated-cross-border-capabilities. Same transaction, different documents.

evidence.text: Peers that reported after XYF last spoke (2026-08-24) show the Q3 funding squeeze. QFIN Q3 volume was RMB49.5bn (-21.9% QoQ), net revenue -13.4% QoQ, profit about -73% YoY, and it guides Q4 volume down another ~20% QoQ. FINV mainland volume was RMB15.8bn (-66.8% YoY, against about RMB41bn in Q2), with net revenue -24.8% QoQ and net profit -51.8% QoQ. LX guided a significant QoQ drop in Q3 originations and a possible net loss. That implies XYF's Q3 volume and revenue land well below the Q2 run-rate (RMB11.63bn, RMB993.6m), with a real risk of a loss against Q2's RMB47.0m profit.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No trustworthy XYF reaction history (FPI, baseline n=0). On 2026-11-25, peer day, QFIN US was reportedly -7.59% on its print (ticker widget; the same article quotes a -2.12% prior-day close) and XYF was +0.38%. XYF ignored peer read-through because the bid anchors it.
evidence.why_not_priced: XYF's price has not moved on the peer prints (+0.38% on 11-25 while QFIN fell), because it trades the deal spread. If the read-through were priced, the spread to US$6.03 would have widened on 11-25. It stayed at about 13%. The deal also caps how much a bad print can hurt, which is why the size is small. XYF had already shrunk 70% YoY by Q2, so its QoQ decline may be smaller than FINV's.
evidence.independence: QFIN Q3 2026: https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/qfin-q3-2026-slides-profit-plunges-72-as-china-credit-stress-deepens-93CH-4979733 (2026-11-25). LX Q2 guidance of a Q3 decline: https://6ix.com/news/lexinfintech-holdings-ltd-to-report-third-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-on-december-4-2026-beijing-time. Sector context: Caixin 2026-09-10, https://www.caixinglobal.com/2026-09-10/chinas-online-lenders-see-profits-plunge-as-new-rules-bite-102483449.html. These are separate companies' documents, but the transmission to XYF is a proxy.

evidence.text: Q2's RMB47.0m net income rested on two items that may not repeat. First, a partial reversal of the contingent guarantee provision (down to RMB57.6m), which management said not to treat 'as a new lower run rate'; non-repeat would push Q3 down. Second, a RMB95.3m one-off credit-loss provision on deposits held with one funding partner whose business is 'basically gone'; non-repeat would push Q3 up. Net, Q3 earnings quality leans slightly negative.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No usable history. The Q2 print, where these items landed, has no sourced price reaction.
evidence.why_not_priced: With no consensus and no analyst coverage, nobody has adjusted the RMB47m run-rate for the reversal. The bid caps the effect, and the two items partly offset, so the size is small.
evidence.independence: Q2 release figures: https://finviz.com/news/384651/x-financial-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results. Same company disclosure set as the call, so not independent.

evidence.text: The US$100m buyback ends 2026-11-30 with about US$35.5m unused as of 2026-08-14. The pace slowed to about US$4.3m between 05-15 and 08-14, and the CFO said in August there was no further buyback plan. With a controller take-private pending, a renewal alongside Q3 is unlikely and is not expected, so its absence is not news. The semi-annual dividend (US$0.28/ADS) was paid in September; the next one is normally with Q4 results.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced reaction to past buyback announcements.
evidence.why_not_priced: Nothing to price. The expected outcome, no renewal, is consistent with a pending take-private. A surprise renewal or special dividend would be odd under a controller bid.

evidence.text: Credit is stabilising sequentially at XYF and at peers. XYF Q2 31-60 DPD fell to 1.73% from 2.61% in Q1, 91-180 fell to 9.09% from 9.95%, and management said recent vintages perform better. QFIN's 90+ improved to 2.50% from 2.83% QoQ, with its 30-day collection rate at 86.0% against 84.1%. A further sequential improvement in XYF's Q3 delinquency buckets is likely and would partly offset the volume decline.
evidence.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: the Q2 trend was public. The Q3 extension is an inference from the company trend plus a peer proxy, and the deal anchor damps it.
evidence.independence: QFIN 90+ 2.50% from 2.83%: https://www.webull.com/news/15981414007202816 and https://longbridge.com/en/news/306731245 (2026-11-25). QFIN warns C-M2 could rise in Q4 (https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/qfin-q3-2026-slides-profit-plunges-72-as-china-credit-stress-deepens-93CH-4979733), which cuts against this somewhat; that is already reflected in the small size.
